columns.name: carrier_account
columns.reason: Standing shipping account on file for the unit, not an outcome record.

columns.name: smart_health_index
columns.reason: Drive telemetry read before the claim is filed; predictive but final at prediction time.

columns.name: controller_type
columns.reason: Static hardware attribute of the drive.

columns.name: erase_method
columns.reason: Sanitization is performed on the disposition path, after the approval decision.

columns.name: firmware_rev
columns.reason: Firmware revision is recorded on the unit before it is returned.

columns.name: interface_type
columns.reason: Static hardware attribute fixed at manufacture.

columns.name: qa_sample_flag
columns.reason: Unit provenance flag set long before the claim.

columns.name: test_bench_id
columns.reason: Internal diagnostic bench used at intake triage, before the vendor adjudicates.

columns.name: warranty_tier
columns.reason: Contract tier fixed at purchase; strongly predictive but known in advance.

columns.name: return_freight_usd
columns.reason: Return shipping cost only accrues once the RMA is granted and the unit ships.

columns.name: inbound_dock
columns.reason: Recorded when the failed drive is received, before adjudication.

columns.name: depot_code
columns.reason: Receiving depot is known at intake.

columns.name: asset_tag_prefix
columns.reason: Static asset-labelling attribute.

columns.name: temp_max_c
columns.reason: Operating telemetry captured before the drive was pulled.

columns.name: recycler_code
columns.reason: A recycler is assigned only on the scrap path, so it encodes the disposition outcome.

columns.name: postmortem_reallocated_sectors
columns.reason: Postmortem teardown measurement produced after the claim and used to justify the ruling.

columns.name: cert_template
columns.reason: The certificate is issued at case closure and its template reflects the outcome.

columns.name: operator_shift
columns.reason: Shift of the technician handling intake, known at that moment.

columns.name: capacity_class
columns.reason: Static product attribute.

columns.name: vendor_triage_code
columns.reason: The vendor's triage classification is the basis on which approval is assigned.

columns.name: purchase_lot
columns.reason: Procurement attribute fixed at purchase.

columns.name: audit_batch
columns.reason: Reads as an operational grouping identifier rather than a record of the ruling.

columns.name: power_on_hours
columns.reason: SMART counter is final when the drive is pulled from service.

columns.name: load_cycle_count
columns.reason: SMART counter is final when the drive is pulled from service.

columns.name: chassis_slot
columns.reason: Deployment position known before the failure.

columns.name: pallet_id
columns.reason: Consolidation identifier for the inbound movement to the depot.

columns.name: packaging_spec
columns.reason: Packaging standard is a policy attribute applied at handling, carrying no outcome content.

columns.name: fleet_group
columns.reason: Deployment grouping assigned when the drive entered service.

columns.name: vendor_region
columns.reason: Static supplier attribute known before the claim.

columns.name: raid_level
columns.reason: Array configuration in place while the drive was deployed.

columns.name: model_family
columns.reason: Static product attribute.

columns.name: label_printer
columns.reason: Device used for intake labelling; incidental operational metadata.

columns.name: data_recovery_hours
columns.reason: Effort accumulates over the life of the case and is not final when the claim is filed.

columns.name: spin_retry_count
columns.reason: SMART counter final at the time the drive is pulled.

columns.name: site_code
columns.reason: Location of the drive, known before the claim.

columns.name: shipment_batch
columns.reason: Batch grouping from the inbound/procurement leg, established before adjudication.

columns.name: rma_queue
columns.reason: Routing queue is set when the claim is filed, before it is decided.

columns.name: rack_row
columns.reason: Deployment location known before failure.

columns.name: disposition_office
columns.reason: Assigned at final disposition, which follows the approval outcome.

columns.name: days_to_disposition
columns.reason: A duration that can only be computed once the case has closed.
